purpose: Package reproducible AgentDojo evaluation for frozen original Qwen3.8-27B and the completed clean-T+ OPCD adapter, plus lossless <=90000-byte TXT transport.

benchmark_scan.data: Four complete upstream suites, environments, injection vectors, task classes, ground-truth checks and static important_instructions attack
benchmark_scan.selection: All official tasks; no convenient subset in formal run
benchmark_scan.evaluation: Official procedural utility/security, with trace-first fallbacks; no paid LLM judge

baseline_scan.matched: Same interface, tasks, injection text, role=input, repeat_user_prompt for attacks, greedy decoding and 32K context
baseline_scan.further_research: A full paper claim would require other method baselines; this engineering package does not establish superiority.

reusable_code.AgentDojo: Entire src tree and data copied from pinned Git object, with no scorer/task modifications
reusable_code.SecOPD: Pinned Qwen tool-call parser and message adapter retained separately with license; local request transport adds full raw request/response logs and deterministic per-case seeds

runtime.schedule: Base then trained sequentially on one free B200; the training adapter is merged into a separate local checkpoint without modifying the original model
runtime.checkpoint: Completed final training checkpoint pinned and SHA256 checked; evaluation never selects a checkpoint from scores
runtime.output: output/agentdojo/, including per-case traces, request/response JSON, raw official scores, summaries and all process logs
runtime.errors: Recorded separately with null validated metrics; official raw fallback values remain inspectable
runtime.budget: Only CPU/deterministic checks here; full B200 model evaluation starts only when operator launches the included command

transfer.format: Readable UTF-8 text stream carrying original file boundaries, lengths and SHA256; each part has transfer identity, index, count, payload hash and hash chain; root control file binds complete stream hash
checks: every restored file size and SHA256
transfer.scientific_boundary: Transfer integrity is not benchmark validity; partial or failed runs remain explicitly partial/failed after transfer.
